Cursed Stage 戏怨

Trailer for a Haunted Theatre Experience.

The Trailer

Twenty years ago, the most glamorous theatre in the capital was consumed by a raging fire.

Its star performer — Jin Xiu — perished in the flames.

But her spirit never left.

They say that every Halloween night, faint echoes of her singing drift through the ruins…

This Halloween —

will you dare to enter the theatre cursed by Jin Xiu’s final performance?

A group of college students on an adventure.

A dangerous séance.

A truth buried beneath ash and sorrow.

In the darkness, the story awaits you.

Here, you are not just the audience —

you are part of the tale.

Perhaps the leader of the expedition,

perhaps the one possessed,

or perhaps… the chosen substitute — handpicked by Jin Xiu herself.
